name: Getac F110-EX G7
summary: The Getac F110-EX G7 is the hazardous-area version of a Getac rugged 11.6-inch tablet, certified for Zone 2/22 under IECEx. Getac also states ATEX certification, but the certificate isn't published. It is an intrinsically safe (Ex ic) design running Windows 11 Pro.

atex.marking: II 3G Ex ic op is IIC T4 Gc / II 3D Ex ic op is IIIC T130°C Dc
atex.status: IECEx Current, issue 2 (2025-01-31), checked 2026-10-25; ATEX certificate not published; UKEX not found

iecex.marking: Ex ic op is IIC T4 Gc / Ex ic op is IIIC T130°C Dc

certification.protection: Intrinsic safety (Ex ic) with inherently safe optical radiation (op is)

safety.conditions: Use only in a controlled environment with suitably reduced pollution. Protect from impacts with high impact energy, high electrostatic charge generating processes and excessive UV light. Connection interfaces never used in hazardous areas. Battery never changed, charged or removed in hazardous areas. Use only Li-ion battery BP3S1P2680B or BP3S2P2100S-02.
safety.peripherals: All connection interfaces (USB, Thunderbolt, DC-in, docking connector, LAN, serial) must never be used in hazardous areas (certificate condition). Optional internal modules named in the certificate are covered as part of the certified tablet. SIM and spare main storage (SSD canister) are replaceable in non-hazardous areas only.
safety.certifiedAccessories: Named in the IECEx certificate as usable with the tablet: shoulder strap, hand strap, 4-point shoulder harness, capacitive hard-tip stylus and tether, digitizer pen and tether. Anti-static screen protection film (Getac accessory made for hazardous use). Hard handle (factory option, datasheet) is NOT named in the certificate accessory list. Keyboard: none offered for F110-EX. NOT for hazardous areas (Getac accessory brochure): AC adapters, multi-bay and external chargers, spare batteries (replace in non-hazardous areas only). DS100 USB-C docking station (datasheet option) is not an Ex-listed accessory.

os.name: Windows
os.updates: Windows 11: supported while kept on a current version (Microsoft Modern Lifecycle)

specs.display: 11.6-inch TFT LCD, wide viewing angle, LumiBond optically bonded
specs.chip: Intel Core i5-1335U / i5-1345U vPro / i7-1355U / i7-1365U vPro (13th gen)
specs.frontCamera: 5 MP webcam, or optional 5 MP Windows Hello camera
specs.battery: 2 x 2680 typical (2 x 2640 min), 11.4 V; optional 2 x 4200 typical (4080 min), 11.1 V
specs.hotSwap: Yes, "LifeSupport battery swappable technology" (non-hazardous areas only)
specs.ports: Thunderbolt 4 Type-C x1, USB 3.2 Gen2 Type-A x1, DC-in, audio combo; top slot: 1D/2D barcode or serial + LAN; right slot: HF RFID or fingerprint reader; smart card reader (back); micro-SIM; all ports barred from hazardous areas
specs.docking: Getac DS100 USB-C docking station (non-hazardous areas)
specs.nfc: Optional HF RFID reader (13.56 MHz, ISO 15693, 14443 A/B, Mifare, FeliCa)
specs.gnss: Optional dedicated GPS with L1/L5, or via 4G/5G module
specs.sim: Micro-SIM (3FF), optional dual SIM with eSIM
specs.biometrics: Optional fingerprint reader, optional Windows Hello face camera
specs.touch: Dual-mode touchscreen (multi-touch and digitizer); glove/wet mode not stated in datasheet
specs.pen: Yes, digitizer pen with tether (dual-mode touch)
specs.apps: Getac Utility, Camera, Geolocation, Barcode Manager, KeyWedge Barcode Reader Utility (trial)
specs.storage: 256 GB PCIe NVMe SSD (options 512 GB, 1000 GB, 2000 GB)
specs.ruggedness: MIL-STD-810H; 1.2 m (4 ft) drop in use

capabilities.label: Barcode scanning
capabilities.value: Built in (optional integrated 1D/2D imager, factory option)

capabilities.label: RFID
capabilities.value: Built in (optional HF RFID reader, 13.56 MHz)

capabilities.label: NFC reading
capabilities.value: Built in (via optional HF RFID reader: ISO 14443, Mifare, FeliCa)

capabilities.label: Remote expert / video calls
capabilities.value: Via app (5 MP front and 8 MP rear camera; Windows)

unconfirmed.certification.iecex.number: Getac's certificate names the model with a 'c' suffix and doesn't name the generation. We matched it to this generation by its batteries, dust group and ambient range.
unconfirmed.safety.certifiedAccessories: Not checked against the certificate for this exact model.
unconfirmed.os.edition: The maker doesn't state the edition year.

strengths: Certified for ambient temperatures up to +60 °C
limitations: Zone 2 only, so not for Zone 1 areas
T4 temperature class: fine for most gases, but not those that ignite below 135 °C
